# The #11/#12 layouts remain deliberately byte-identical for historical fixtures,
# offline tools and explicitly classical validator sets. As live production moves
# away from them, the inventory has to be a thing that fails rather than a paragraph
# someone remembers to update: adding a site, removing one, or converting one without
# updating its disposition fails the check in both directions.
# Only Git-tracked inputs belong here. tl/generate/auto/** is generated into a
# developer's source tree during a build and is absent from a clean checkout. Its
# authoritative inputs, tl/generate/scheme/tos_api.tl and lite_api.tl, are listed
# below; listing their derived C++ mirrors would add no independent coverage and
# would make the gate depend on whether the checkout happened to be built already.
#   definition   the class, factory, schema or codec itself
#   historical   reachable only for historical fixtures, offline tools or explicitly
#                classical validator sets, never from a post-quantum production path
#   placeholder  an empty classical set used as a null object rather than evidence
#   reachable    a live production path can still produce or accept it; the reason names
#                the unit that owns its conversion
